description: Represents a body paragraph of running prose as ONE text_block: ordinary reading text that is not a heading, table, figure, equation, caption, list, or code.
applicability: The region is a paragraph (or a run of sentences) of ordinary prose.
The text is not a section title, not tabular, not a caption, and not a list or code block.
instructions: Emit each paragraph as ONE block of block_type text_block, carrying its full text.
Keep a paragraph's sentences together — do NOT split one paragraph into sibling blocks on a mere line break; and do NOT merge two visually separate paragraphs into one.

A paragraph that continues onto the next page is ONE unit: if it began on a previous page (see CarryState open_units), reuse that unit's stitch_id so the fragments merge; a page starting mid-paragraph does NOT start a new block.
Do NOT nest paragraphs under one another; a plain paragraph has no parent unless it clearly belongs to a heading (then set parent_block_id to that heading).
Never emit a heading, table, figure, caption, list, or equation as a text_block.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): a plain prose paragraph is its own structural entity, distinct from the legal numbered_point clause tree.
